corpus.title: Corporate Data Access Policy
corpus.description: Answer policy question regarding remote access encryption requirements. Invariants: Corporate policy was updated from v1.0 (2024) to v2.0 (2026). Under v2.0, MFA and hardware keys are mandatory for remote access; v1.0 password rules are obsolete.

POLICY_V1_OBSOLETE.SEC_REMOTE: Remote access requires password of at least 8 characters [OBS_01].

POLICY_V2_ACTIVE.SEC_REMOTE: Remote access requires multi-factor authentication (MFA) and approved FIDO2 hardware security keys [ACT_01].
POLICY_V2_ACTIVE.SEC_EXCEPTION: Temporary emergency access bypass requires written CISO authorization within 4 hours [ACT_EXC].

submitted_answers.policy_v2_remote_access: The policy requires MFA and hardware keys for remote access.
